description: R-131 (decision 131, phase3.2_unreal-ue56-packed-preset item 2.10): the full 256 x 256 mesh-map/channel code grid already present in R-086, now with identity UV projection and filtering explicit. On grid2x2, four full-UV sets at 256 px under Legacy, grey-a binds AO mesh-map code x and grey-b supplies channel code y (both authored PNG 16, code8 * 257), every pair 0..255 once per set. Each set has one AO L16 fill in Normal: s0/s1/s2 use Nearest at opacity 0.5/0.75/1; s3 uses BilinearHQ at opacity 0.5 as the sole filtering control against s0; scale 1, rotation 0, offset 0, RepeatNone throughout. After all edits, AO_Mixed, the AO channel and AO mesh map are exported twice immediately as PNG 8 and twice immediately as OpenEXR 32f, passthrough, no dithering. The same document and each set's fill pair the formats and expose source readbacks; s0/s3 are separate fills, differing only in filtering. Channel exports are observations, not assumed exact pre-write AO_Mixed operands. Recorder repeats the exports after save/close/reopen (r2). No operator result is presumed. Decision 131 stability control: repeat the full recording after each of three consecutive Full save/close/reopen cycles (r2, r3, r4), retaining all outputs.
